items.title: Build a canonical fleet work-admission and deduplication control plane
items.summary: Create a single fleet-level view and admission contract for proposals, change requests, work items, active slots, site overlap, measurement windows, failures, and terminal dispositions. Reject or consolidate duplicates before queue admission and show the exact blocker or next owner action.
items.requested_action: Approve a product specification for the existing engineer queue. Include canonical identity rules, one-active-change-per-site safeguards, capacity-aware admission, failure-to-repair linkage, owner and deadline fields, audit history, and rollback-safe behavior. Do not change schedules, permissions, telemetry, or production state.

items.title: Create a measurement-debt and outcome-readiness cockpit
items.summary: Expose deployed improvements awaiting measurement, due dates, available baseline fields, attribution limitations, failed or cancelled request links, and proven/inconclusive/regressed outcomes in one operator workflow.
items.requested_action: Approve a read-only product specification using existing intelligence and outcome records. The cockpit must preserve unknowns, distinguish measurement readiness from success, avoid creating telemetry, and route only approved follow-up work through the existing queue.
